title: Show and Sell: Studying the Effects of Branded Cigarette Product Placement in TV Shows on Cigarette Sales
authors: Ali Goli; Simha Mummalaneni; Pradeep K. Chintagunta; Sanjay K. Dhar
eligible_reason: Branded cigarette product placement on TV and sales: store-brand-week log sales regressed on continuous log placement goodwill (own and competitor) with brand-month, store-brand and store-week FE, plus a DMA-border design. Continuous treatment, no binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: Code+SyntheticData/Run.R.R: felm(ln_units ~ ln_plmt_gwill + ln_plmt_gwill_competitor + price/feature/display | brand_month + store_brand + store_wyear) national and border samples.
data_files_note: README: synthetic datasets bearing no relationship to the real data.
